description_for_human: A brutalist forge for generating ready-to-run Base Chain AI Agent source code. Supports Auto-Trader, Sentiment-Bot, and Gas-Watcher templates.
description_for_model: A tool to generate ready-to-run source code for Base Chain AI Agents. Provides templates for trading bots, gas monitors, and sentiment analysis. Input parameters: template_type (autotrader/sentiment/gaswatcher), agent_name, rpc_url. Returns deployable Python code.
